---
title: "The paintings"
description: "The works by Candido Portinari behind each palette, with links to the collections."
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(PortinariColors)

swatch_html <- function(palette) {
  cols <- as.character(portinari.pal(palette))
  cells <- paste0(
    '<div style="flex:1;background:', cols, ';height:44px;" title="', cols, '"></div>',
    collapse = ""
  )
  paste0('<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin:0.5rem 0 1rem;">',
         cells, "</div>")
}

work_html <- function(w) {
  img <- if (!is.na(w$image_url)) {
    paste0('<a href="', w$url, '"><img src="', w$image_url, '" alt="', w$title,
           '" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;"></a>')
  } else {
    paste0('<a href="', w$url, '" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;',
           'height:220px;border-radius:6px;background:#f2f2f2;text-align:center;padding:1rem;">',
           'View the panel at Google Arts &amp; Culture &rarr;</a>')
  }
  paste0('<figure style="margin:0;">', img,
         '<figcaption style="font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:0.4rem;"><a href="', w$url, '"><em>',
         w$title, '</em></a>, ', w$year, '<br><span style="color:#666;">', w$collection,
         if (!is.na(w$inventory)) paste0(" &middot; ", w$inventory) else "",
         "</span></figcaption></figure>")
}

palette_section <- function(palette) {
  info <- portinari.palettes()
  row <- info[info$palette == palette, ]
  works <- portinari.works(palette)
  grid <- paste0('<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:1rem;">',
                 paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(works)), function(i) work_html(works[i, ]), ""), collapse = ""),
                 "</div>")
  cat("\n\n## `", palette, "`\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**", tools::toTitleCase(row$category), "** &middot; ", row$n_colors, " colors &middot; ",
      if (row$colorblind_friendly) "colorblind-friendly" else paste0("first ", row$cvd_n, " colorblind-safe"),
      "\n\n", row$description, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(swatch_html(palette), "\n\n", grid, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

Each palette is drawn from one or more works by Candido Portinari
(1903&ndash;1962). Eight are in the collection of the
[Museu de Arte de S&atilde;o Paulo (MASP)](https://masp.org.br/en/collections);
*Guerra* and *Paz* are the two panels he painted for the United Nations
Headquarters in New York. Click an image or title to open the work's page.

The palettes are an interpretation of each work's dominant tones, not a
measurement of it. Images are shown from the MASP collection site and remain
under copyright.

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
for (p in c("cafe", "retirantes", "inah", "sofia", "guerra", "paz")) palette_section(p)
```

## Derived sequential palettes

`guerra_azul` and `paz_ouro` are taken from the panels above: the blue scale
of *Guerra* and the earth-to-gold run of *Paz*, ordered from dark to light.

```{r derived, results = "asis"}
for (p in c("guerra_azul", "paz_ouro")) cat("\n**`", p, "`**\n\n", swatch_html(p), "\n\n", sep = "")
```
